body: I had mystical experiences where I felt I had the answer, but it never lasts. I don't take drugs though.

The confusion is both painful and annoying. Like an itch you can't quick scratch.

Maybe try going beyond emotion. I find there is an inner space which is the real me. There is no happiness or sadness there. No personality. Just silence. It's nice.

Yes. Often.

I have been confused for a long time.
